name: @onegrid/print
description: Print and advanced export for oneGrid — a pagination engine that lays rows and columns onto real A4/Letter/Legal/A3 page boxes (column banding with repeated key columns, no row ever split across a page break, correct total page counts), a dependency-free PDF writer, a @media print stylesheet emitter for native browser printing, canvas screenshot capture with tall-grid tiling, and format-preserving styled output that carries number formats, alignment and conditional colours instead of flattening to text.
